source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:1902.09304 preprint, corroborating the 2025 Biometrical Journal article
source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 4-5, Section 2.2.1, Equation (2); p. 15 frailty-model discussion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines TV-SACE as a two-index difference in cumulative nonterminal-event incidence among always-survivors and uses a parametric shared-frailty illness-death approach.
Theorem 3.1 bounds scalar SACE through integrals of pointwise tail bounds; the paper addresses always-survivor and related strata under truncation by death.
The article proposes fixed-population semi-competing-risk estimands, derives partial-identification results, sensitivity analysis, and conditions for full identification.
The article proposes identification and estimation for bounds on continuous functionals of the joint potential-outcome distribution and documents a linear-program implementation in its supplements.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 1, Abstract; pp. 12-13, optimal-transport endpoint characterization
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper characterizes scalar sharp identified-set endpoints by optimal-transport values and proposes dual-based estimators and inference.
The cited work assumes independent right censoring on a finite horizon and develops concentration inequalities for IPCW/Kaplan-Meier-type quantities.
